1.0.1: Ember Sync: sign in with your Lareon account in Settings and your bookmarks, pinned sites and preferences follow you to every device.
Ember now opens Fledge, Lareon’s email, from the sidebar.
Pin tabs, snooze them for later, or make them temporary. Right-click a tab.
A plain-English site check on the lock: what to watch for, plus Forget this site.
Safer downloads: warnings for files pretending to be something else.
Calm mode, focus sessions, reader view and clean links.
Settings (Ctrl+,), a bookmarks bar, and bookmark import from Chrome, Edge or Brave.
Type maths or conversions like 18% of 240 or 5 miles to km in the address bar.
0.9.6: Ember now shows what’s new after it updates, like this window.
Clicking Restart now in the update window restarts Ember right away.
0.9.7: Find in page: press Ctrl+F to search the page you’re on.
Bookmarks: press Ctrl+D or tap the star in the toolbar, and find them in the Library.
Right-click menu: open links in a new tab, copy, paste, search for selected text and more.
Mute any tab that’s playing sound with the speaker icon on the tab.
Tab search: press Ctrl+Shift+A to jump to any open tab.
Clear data: in the Library, clear history, cookies and cache whenever you like.
